translations.web: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
translations.bsb: But Abram replied, “Lord GOD, how can I know that I will possess it?”
translations.kjv: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
translations.asv: And he said, O Lord Jehovah, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
